relationships.subject: Medication underuse
relationships.evidence_quote: The underuse of both acute and preventive medications has been shown to contribute to the progression of migraine.

relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP medications
relationships.evidence_quote: Research suggests that initiating preventive anti-CGRP treatment at an early stage (during low frequency episodic migraine attacks) is more beneficial than commencing it during high frequency episodic attacks or when chronic migraine has begun.

key_findings: Underuse of acute and preventive migraine medications contributes to migraine progression.
